newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EVEA RAISES PROFIT ESTIMATE BY 2 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: EVEA RAISES PROFIT ESTIMATE BY 2 MLN KROONS.

text.p: EVEA Pank raised its profit before tax estimate for 1997 by two million kroons to 15 million kroons, the bank said on Thursday.
"The increased profit will be gained by more active operations in the capital and money markets," the bank said in a statement.
The bank also said that it had revised its growth estimate for assets from 500 million kroons to over 500 million kroons but did not give a specific figure.
Its assets at the end of March were 482.4 million kroons.
The bank is one of the smallest in Estonia.
The bank said its council voted Boris Shpugin as board chairman again.
It also voted Ain Noormagi, the managing director of the Small Business Association, as its chairman.
